caseName: Journeymen Stone Cutters Ass'n v. United States
caseNameFull: Journeymen Stone Cutters Ass'n v. United States
attorneys: Mr. Jeremiah A. O’Leary, with whom Messrs. Frank P. Walsh, Roderick Begg, and Theodore R. Jaffe were on the brief, for appellants., Solicitor General Mitchell and Assistant to the Attorney General Donovan for-the United States.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The appeal is dismissed for lack of a showing of service of summons and severance upon those defendants in the court below who did not join in the appeal. Masterson v. Herndon, 10 Wall. 416; Downing v. McCartney, 131 U. S. 98 App’x.; Hardee v. Wilson, 146 U. S. 179; Garcia v. Vela, 216 U. S. 598.
